title: Connect Your Agent To YOU
description: Expose your factories over MCP so an AI agent can run them for you.
openingSummary: MCP turns your factories into tools an agent can call. Once connected, an agent can start runs, submit work, and read results without you driving the CLI.

whatItIs.title: What It Is
whatItIs.body: The MCP server presents each factory capability as a tool. Any MCP-speaking harness — Claude, Codex, Cursor, and others — can discover and call them.

whenToUse.title: When To Use
whenToUse.body: Use this once you have a factory worth reusing. It is the difference between running a workflow yourself and having an agent reach for it when it needs one.

stepsOrWorkflow.title: Steps Or Workflow
stepsOrWorkflow.body: Start the MCP server, register it with your harness, then ask the agent to list its tools to confirm the connection.

commonPitfalls.title: Common Pitfalls
commonPitfalls.body: The agent can only do what the server exposes. If a tool is missing, the factory is not published rather than the connection being broken — check what the server advertises before debugging the harness.
